Create a class with __init__ and make an object.

class Student:
    def __init__(self, name, roll): # constructor
        self.name = name # instance variables
        self.roll = roll
    def show(self):
        print(f"Name: {self.name}, Roll: {self.roll}")
s1 = Student("Surya", 383)
s2 = Student("Amit", 384)
s1.show()
s2.show()
Note: __init__ runs automatically when an object is created. self refers to that object.
